title: Facial-feedback Registered Replication Report: direct multi-lab estimate for Strack et al. protocol
summary: Promotes the facial-feedback RRR as a direct multi-lab replication record. It captures the original-to-replication contrast and keeps the status at the specific Strack et al. pen-in-mouth protocol rather than the entire facial-feedback literature.

status_history.note: Promoted or created in rev0012 multi-lab replication / boundary-map pass.
